d:
Hum Teri Mohabbat Mein is one of the most soulful romantic tracks from the 90s Bollywood era.
From the movie Phool Aur Angaar (1993), this heartfelt song features Mithun Chakraborty and Shantipriya in a touching portrayal of love and emotion. Beautifully sung by Kumar Sanu and Sadhana Sargam, with melodious music by Anand–Milind, this timeless tune continues to win hearts even today.
